payload.role_in_assembly: This is the main bottleneck: it excludes every earlier grid point from being a maximizer.

k is an integer with 1 less than or equal to k less than or equal to n
x ranges over all real numbers

Determine the set of real x that maximize f_n(x) over all real numbers x, and determine the maximum value of f_n(x).
